quarterly_data.signal: On August 27, 2026, Solstice and Element Solutions entered into a Termination Agreement mutually terminating their July 6, 2026 merger agreement, under which Solstice was to acquire Element Solutions; no fees are payable by either party. Solstice affirmed its guidance for the third quarter of 2026 and its increased full-year 2026 guidance, including net sales of $4,125 - $4,185 million for full-year 2026 and $990 - $1,030 million for the third quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: Element Solutions merger agreement terminated (no fees); net sales guidance $4,125 - $4,185 million (FY2026) and $990 - $1,030 million (Q3 2026) affirmed
